reviewer: Claude Code (Opus, orchestrating session) — self-review of the Sonnet implementation agents' work

importantFindings.title: At 320 px with 200% text the two-column crew summary truncated names to 'A..'
importantFindings.evidence: Screenshot of the first read view (b2c0cea).
importantFindings.disposition: Fixed in c857f26: the column rule follows the text size (minmax(min(100%, 9rem), 1fr), later 8.8rem), names and the title wrap; a D1 10×4 course was added to the fit test.

importantFindings.title: Exported crew cards had a fixed 176 px floor that left two-person cards half empty
importantFindings.disposition: Fixed in dcca297: the floor is what the number needs; the same image is 11% shorter.

importantFindings.title: The Comandate summary: names spread down a stretched card, day labels smaller than the names in the image, the minor badge at the card's edge
importantFindings.evidence: Screenshots and the exported PNG of the first Comandate version.
importantFindings.disposition: Fixed before 7811fad: content-start on the names, a 40 px day label, badges placed after the name's last line in the shared image module (both images).

importantFindings.title: The exporter kept a stale copy of the old gommone paths
importantFindings.evidence: crewSummaryImage.ts after the interrupted export agent still drew the pre-629e09d mark with a shaft and a console.
importantFindings.disposition: Fixed in dcca297: boatMarks.ts is the one source for the app icon and the image; tests pin it.

importantFindings.title: The first full evidence run failed one WebKit timing test
importantFindings.evidence: u04-scan-ui 'tilt updates the crop image live' (100 ms budget) failed on iphone-13-webkit-core while the independent reviewer ran tests in parallel; F3 changes no scan file (git diff f1a03e1 7811fad -- src/features/students src/capabilities is empty).
importantFindings.disposition: Load-induced: the spec passed 3 of 3 alone; the final evidence run was recorded with the machine otherwise idle.

qolFindings.title: The design page (claude.ai canvas) re-saved two boards and dropped content because of a valueless data attribute
qolFindings.disposition: Fixed on the page; later boards carry no data-* hooks. Not part of the app.
